同名、跨来源同 ID 的歌曲按 source/id 点赞、排序和删除。

-- setup --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "type": "user.update",
  "requestId": "user",
  "data": {
    "name": "alice",
    "email": " A@B.C ",
    "clientTimeMs": 100
  }
}

-- setup --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "type": "music.pick",
  "requestId": "pick-current",
  "data": {
    "source": "qq",
    "id": "current"
  }
}

-- setup --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "type": "music.pick",
  "requestId": "pick-qq",
  "data": {
    "source": "qq",
    "id": "shared"
  }
}

-- setup --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "type": "music.pick",
  "requestId": "pick-netease",
  "data": {
    "source": "netease",
    "id": "shared"
  }
}

-- request --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "type": "music.pick",
  "requestId": "duplicate",
  "data": {
    "source": "netease",
    "id": "shared"
  }
}

-- response --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "response",
  "type": "music.pick",
  "requestId": "duplicate",
  "data": {},
  "error": {
    "code": "CONFLICT",
    "message": "重复点歌"
  }
}

-- request --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "type": "queue.get",
  "requestId": "queue",
  "data": {}
}

-- response --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "response",
  "type": "queue.get",
  "requestId": "queue",
  "data": {
    "current": {
      "likes": 0,
      "song": {
        "album": "",
        "artist": "artist",
        "durationMs": 3600000,
        "id": "current",
        "name": "同名歌曲",
        "pictureUrl": "",
        "source": "qq",
        "webUrl": ""
      },
      "user": {
        "name": "alice",
        "emailHash": "5d60d4e28066df254d5452f92c910092"
      }
    },
    "items": [
      {
        "likes": 0,
        "song": {
          "album": "",
          "artist": "artist",
          "durationMs": 3600000,
          "id": "shared",
          "name": "同名歌曲",
          "pictureUrl": "",
          "source": "qq",
          "webUrl": ""
        },
        "user": {
          "name": "alice",
          "emailHash": "5d60d4e28066df254d5452f92c910092"
        }
      },
      {
        "likes": 0,
        "song": {
          "album": "",
          "artist": "artist",
          "durationMs": 3600000,

-- request --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "type": "queue.like",
  "requestId": "like",
  "data": {
    "source": "netease",
    "id": "shared"
  }
}

-- response --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "response",
  "type": "queue.like",
  "requestId": "like",
  "data": {
    "id": "shared",
    "likes": 1,
    "source": "netease"
  }
}

-- request --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "type": "queue.remove",
  "requestId": "remove",
  "data": {
    "source": "qq",
    "id": "shared"
  }
}

-- response --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "response",
  "type": "queue.remove",
  "requestId": "remove",
  "data": {
    "id": "shared",
    "source": "qq"
  }
}

-- request --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "type": "queue.get",
  "requestId": "queue-after-remove",
  "data": {}
}
